If $g(t)$ solves Ricci flow and $\psi _t$ solves (8) and is a diffeomorphism, then $(\psi _t^{-1})^*g(t)$ solves (10).
Proof

\sketch Differentiate the pullback and substitute the tension field of $\psi _t$; its Lie derivative is the DeTurck correction.

□

Corollary
[Ricci-DeTurck uniqueness implies Ricci flow uniqueness]
